hints.title: Current Leader
hints.text: Maintain the index of the current winning player and their consecutive win streak.

hints.title: Challenger Simulation
hints.text: Iterate through players 1 to n - 1 as successive challengers. If challenger has higher skill, they become the new leader with 1 win.

hints.title: Early Termination
hints.text: If consecutive wins reach k, return the current leader. If the full array is traversed, the overall maximum player wins.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass through the players array.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating a double-ended queue queue for k steps can take O(k) which is TLE when k = 10^9.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that after at most n - 1 comparisons, the maximum player will never lose.
